title: WisKey tests manifest (arx-exchange schema 1)
description: tests-manifest.json delivered next to the tests ZIP. Lists every file in the tests ZIP with its SHA-256 (it does not list itself). Its own hash is in release-manifest.json artifacts_sha256, which is signed. Strict: unknown fields are rejected. Cross-checks (same version and source_commit as the release manifest, len(excluded) == tests_excluded, every ZIP member listed exactly once) are done by the Arx gate, see GATE.md.

requirements_file.description: Pinned test requirements inside the tests ZIP (normally requirements-ha-test.txt). Must also appear in 'files'. Every requirement is pinned with == and installable from the prepared wheelhouse without network.

role.description: test = test module; support = conftest/helpers; tool = script the tests call; metadata = pyproject/setup.cfg/requirements; fixture = synthetic input data; doc_input = documentation or catalog file a test reads.

expected_collected.description: Exact number of test cases the test command must collect in the gate (after exclusions). Fewer collected = missing tests = failure.

tests_excluded.description: Equals the length of 'excluded' and release-manifest.json tests_excluded.

node_id.description: pytest node id, for example tests/test_x.py::test_y[param].

category.description: Shown separately by Arx so a constant total cannot hide a swap.

marker.description: pytest marker that excludes it (hardware, repo_only, ...).

baseline.description: The approved exclusions baseline this release is compared with (BASELINE_EXCLUSIONS.md).
